Algeria — the existing corpus (af-egypt-algeria-provincial.json) already has the Wilaya Code's equalisation articles (Loi n°12-07, Art. 176-179) but no actual budget document with real transferred figures, and nothing at the commune (Algeria's ~1,541-commune lowest tier) level. This round found the richest single result of the whole municipal-tier push: Algeria's annual Loi de Finances publishes an official annex table (État E) giving exact percentage formulas AND real DA-denominated commune-level revenue projections, tax by tax, recurring across at least two budget years.

reports.title: Loi n° 11-10 du 22 juin 2011 relative à la commune
reports.description: Algeria's Communal Code, verified via direct download from the Journal Officiel (joradp.dz, N°37, 3 juillet 2011) and cross-checked against a FAOLEX mirror. Art. 173: "Les dotations financières d'équipement au titre des concours de l'Etat, du budget de wilaya ou du fonds commun des collectivités locales et autres subventions sont grevées d'affectation spéciale" — the first primary-text naming of the "fonds commun des collectivités locales" (FCCL) at commune level. Art. 195 repeats the FCCL naming for both operating- and investment-section revenue. Art. 211-212 establish the commune-level EQUALISATION mechanism, legally distinct from the wilaya-level Art. 176-179 fund already in corpus: "les communes disposent de deux fonds : — le fonds communal de solidarité ; — le fonds de garantie des collectivités locales", with Art. 212 specifying "une attribution annuelle de péréquation destinée à la section de fonctionnement du budget communal." No percentage/formula is given — implementing 'modalités' are left to a décret not independently located. Art. 188 confirms the internal 'compte administratif' adoption procedure exists in law, though it does not mandate public online disclosure. NAMING CAUTION: the fund is called "fonds commun des collectivités locales" here (2011), but "Caisse de solidarité et de garantie des collectivités locales / CSGCL" in the 2025/2026 Finance Laws' own annex tables, and "Fonds de solidarité et de garantie des collectivités locales / FSGCL" in the 2025 Finance Law's own renaming article (Art. 125) — these all appear to refer to the same Treasury special-allocation account (n°302-020, per dz-loi-finances-2025-etat-e), not three separate funds, but the naming is genuinely inconsistent across primary texts over time.

reports.title: Loi n° 24-08 du 24 novembre 2024 portant loi de finances pour 2025 — État « E »: Liste des impôts et autres impositions et leurs produits affectés à l'État et aux collectivités locales
reports.description: Algeria's 2025 annual Finance Law, État 'E' annex — verified via direct download from joradp.dz (Journal Officiel N°84, 26 December 2024). This is the strongest finding of the whole round: an official annex table giving EXACT per-tax percentage formulas splitting revenue between État, Commune, Wilaya, and 'CSGCL' (the local-solidarity fund), together with real DA-denominated 2025 revenue projections attributed by name to the Commune column. Verbatim: "TVA intérieure - Hors DGE — 75% [Etat et fonds] / 10% [Commune] / — [Wilaya] / 15% [CSGCL] / 100% [Total]. Prévisions de réalisation 2025: 139 776 654 302 [Etat] / 18 636 887 240 [Commune] / — / 27 955 330 860 [CSGCL] / 186 368 872 403 [Total]." "Taxe sur les produits pétroliers TPP — 66% [Commune] / 29% [Wilaya] / 5% [CSGCL] / 100%. Prévisions de réalisation 2025: 128 852 877 110 [Commune] / 56 617 173 276 [Wilaya] / 9 761 581 599 [CSGCL] / 195 231 631 985 [Total]." Section I total across all Etat/Commune/Wilaya/CSGCL-split taxes for 2025: Commune column alone totals 139 393 198 977 DA. Art. 67 (taxe annuelle d'habitation, as amended): "Le produit de cette taxe est affecté, comme suit : • 50% aux communes ; • 50% aux wilayas." Art. 221 defines the operative Treasury mechanism: "Le compte d'affectation spécial n° 302-020 est intitulé « Fonds de solidarité et de garantie des collectivités locales. »", with recettes including "la contribution annuelle des communes et des wilayas" and dépenses including "des attributions de péréquation." État 'D' (special-account balances) shows the fund's balance at 376 944 433 056 DA as of 31/12/2023. The identical 'Soutien aux collectivités locales' État B budget line (620 696 272 000 DA for 2025) is corroborated by a companion implementing decree, Décret exécutif n°25-14 du 9 janvier 2025.
reports.cadence_note: Annual finance law; this edition is for FY2025 (see dz-loi-finances-2026-etat-e for the recurring FY2026 edition).

reports.title: Loi n° 25-17 du 14 décembre 2025 portant loi de finances pour 2026 — État « E »
reports.description: The FY2026 edition of the same État 'E' mechanism as dz-loi-finances-2025-etat-e, confirming it is a stable, recurring annual budget structure rather than a one-off — verified via direct download from joradp.dz (Journal Officiel N°88, 31 December 2025). Same formulas repeated with updated 2026 figures: "TVA intérieure-Hors DGE 75% [Etat et fonds] / 10% [Commune] / — [Wilaya] / 15% [CSGCL] / 100%. Prévisions de réalisation 2026: 170 102 250 000 [Etat] / 22 680 300 000 [Commune]..."; Section I total for 2026: Commune column 57 108 534 776 DA. TPP formula (66% Commune / 29% Wilaya / 5% CSGCL) repeated with 2026 figures: 138 600 000 000 DA to communes. État 'D' shows the special-account balance DECREASED year-over-year: 330 284 806 136,42 DA as of 31/12/2024 (down from 376.9bn a year earlier) — outflows exceeded inflows in 2024. État B's 'Soutien aux collectivités locales' line rose to 659 825 000 000 DA for 2026 (from 620.7bn in 2025). Art. 51 (amending Code du timbre Art. 309) gives a further formula: vignette (vehicle tax) proceeds split 30% État / 20% national pension fund / 50% "Fonds de solidarité et de garantie des collectivités locales" — using the newer FSGCL name (per 2025 Art. 125's renaming), even though this same 2026 law's own État E table still uses the older 'CSGCL' abbreviation, confirming the naming inconsistency persists.
reports.cadence_note: Annual finance law; this edition is for FY2026.

dependencies.basis: The annual Finance Law's État E/D mechanism (the 'CSGCL' special account n°302-020) implements the same fund the Communal Code's Art. 173/195/211-212 establish in principle (under the names 'fonds commun des collectivités locales' / 'fonds communal de solidarité') — the annual law operationalises with real percentages and figures what the 2011 organic code created as an enabling mechanism without specifying a rate.

The 2026 Finance Law's État E/D tables repeat the identical mechanism, formulas, and special-account (n°302-020) structure as the 2025 edition, with updated figures — confirming this is a recurring annual instrument rather than independently establishing the mechanism afresh.

_dropped.edge: Any individual Algerian commune (Oran, Constantine, Annaba, or an Algiers commune) -> a self-published budget/compte administratif document
_dropped.why: Extensive search found no individual commune publishing its own budget primitif, budget supplémentaire, or compte administratif online as a primary document — only secondary news paraphrases (Le Provincial on Annaba/Constantine, Djazairess on Bir El Djir) citing headline figures without the underlying document. A genuine 'collapse to national' finding: the Communal Code's Art. 188 (compte administratif requirement) is the only citable enabling provision; the actual figures live in the national Finance Law's État E table (this file's two main nodes), not in any commune's own publication.

_dropped.edge: ONS (Office National des Statistiques, Algeria) CPI methodology -> COICOP / IMF-ILO CPI Manual / African Charter on Statistics / AFRISTAT
_dropped.why: ons.dz presents a TLS certificate that fails validation against standard trust stores (confirmed via openssl/curl -v: a genuine server-side handshake failure, not a proxy block) on every page and PDF checked, including a targeted methodology note. A Wayback Machine mirror of the same PDF was located but blocked by this round's own egress policy; an r.jina.ai reader-proxy fallback returned HTTP 403. No ONS-authored page discussing these terms surfaced in web search either. Genuine hard technical-access failure, not a content determination either way.
